abilities.name: core/get-site-info
abilities.label: Get Site Information
abilities.description: Returns site information configured in WordPress. By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

abilities.name: core/get-user-info
abilities.label: Get User Information
abilities.description: Returns profile details for the current authenticated user to support personalization, auditing, and access-aware behavior. By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

abilities.name: core/get-environment-info
abilities.label: Get Environment Info
abilities.description: Returns core details about the site's runtime context for diagnostics and compatibility (environment, PHP runtime, database server info, WordPress version). By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

abilities.name: wt/site-selection-read
abilities.label: Read site selection
abilities.description: Returns the current header part candidates and template variants.

abilities.name: wt/site-selection-dry-run
abilities.label: Dry-run site selection change
abilities.description: Computes the diff for a proposed selection change and returns a receipt. No side effects.

abilities.name: wt/site-selection-apply
abilities.label: Apply site selection change
abilities.description: Applies a selection change. Requires the receipt returned by a dry-run; fails without it.
